description: Photogrammétrie - Fond de fossé - Communauté Urbaine de Dunkerque is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by opensig.dkgl.fr. Precise database at 1/500 containing many visible elements of the landscape: roads, enclosures, wooded and grassed areas, canals, buildings. This repository covers the entire territory of the CU Dunkirk and is used as a topographical background for the management of summary preliminary projects or as a topographical study by default. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Photogrammetry - Ditch bottom - Dunkirk Urban Community" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Hydrographie, cud, photogrammétrie, berge, canal, fossé. The listing shows 2021-04-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
